findings.title: No access keys for the root account
findings.remediation: Delete any root account access keys. Use IAM users or roles instead.

findings.title: Root account has MFA enabled
findings.remediation: Enable a virtual or hardware MFA device on the root account.

findings.title: Password policy requires a minimum length of 14 characters
findings.remediation: Set minimum password length to at least 14.

findings.title: Password policy prevents reuse of the last 24 passwords
findings.remediation: Set password reuse prevention to 24 or more.

findings.title: MFA is enabled for IAM users with console access
findings.remediation: Attach an MFA device to 'alice' or remove console access.

findings.title: MFA is enabled for IAM users with console access
findings.remediation: Attach an MFA device to 'bob' or remove console access.

findings.title: MFA is enabled for IAM users with console access
findings.remediation: Attach an MFA device to 'ci-deploy' or remove console access.

findings.title: Active access keys are used within 45 days
findings.remediation: Rotate or deactivate access key AKIARZPUZDIKAHEVREZS for 'ci-deploy'.

findings.title: S3 buckets block public access
findings.remediation: Turn on BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, and RestrictPublicBuckets for the bucket.

findings.title: S3 buckets block public access
findings.remediation: Turn on BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, and RestrictPublicBuckets for the bucket.

findings.title: S3 buckets have default encryption configured
findings.remediation: Set a default encryption rule on the bucket (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS). This check is a best practice; CIS v3.0.0 does not number it.

findings.title: S3 buckets have default encryption configured
findings.remediation: Set a default encryption rule on the bucket (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS). This check is a best practice; CIS v3.0.0 does not number it.

findings.title: At least one CloudTrail trail is logging
findings.remediation: Create a trail and turn logging on. A trail that exists but is stopped does not pass.

findings.title: A logging CloudTrail trail applies to all regions
findings.remediation: Turn on IsMultiRegionTrail for a trail that is logging. A multi-region trail that is stopped does not pass.

findings.title: CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
findings.remediation: Enable log file validation on the trail.

findings.title: Security groups do not allow the world to reach TCP 22
findings.remediation: Remove 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 from inbound rules that include TCP 22.

findings.title: Security groups do not allow the world to reach TCP 3389
findings.evidence: no security group exposes tcp/3389 to the world
findings.remediation: Remove 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 from inbound rules that include TCP 3389.
